definitions.occurrencesReturned: All result occurrences returned across source queries; repeats are included.
definitions.uniqueResults: Results remaining after within-run identifier and title/year reconciliation.
definitions.knownMatches: Unique results already represented in the registry or an earlier intake issue.
definitions.newCandidates: Novel records forwarded to the human intake queue with a plausible or uncertain assessment.
definitions.candidateRate: New intake candidates divided by unique results in a completed run; this is not screening yield.
definitions.sourceCompletionRate: Completed expected source runs divided by all expected source runs; failures are not treated as zero-result searches.
